proof:
change ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], 8 ≤ N → M7.Supports.polynomial (M8.P4Family.support N) = M8.P4Family.polynomial
intro N inst hN
classical
have hv (k : ℕ) (hk : k < N) : (k : ZMod N).val = k := by
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hk]
have h0 : (0 : ZMod N).val = 0 := by simp
have h1 : (1 : ZMod N).val = 1 := by
  simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using hv 1 (by omega)
have h2 : (2 : ZMod N).val = 2 := by
  simpa using hv 2 (by omega)
have h3 : (3 : ZMod N).val = 3 := by
  simpa using hv 3 (by omega)
have h01 : (0 : ZMod N) ≠ 1 := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg ZMod.val h
  omega
have h02 : (0 : ZMod N) ≠ 2 := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg ZMod.val h
  omega
have h03 : (0 : ZMod N) ≠ 3 := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg ZMod.val h
  omega
have h12 : (1 : ZMod N) ≠ 2 := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg ZMod.val h
  omega
have h13 : (1 : ZMod N) ≠ 3 := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg ZMod.val h
  omega
have h23 : (2 : ZMod N) ≠ 3 := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg ZMod.val h
  omega
have hm (k : ℕ) : (Polynomial.monomial k 1 : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial) = Polynomial.X ^ k := by
  ext j
  simp [eq_comm]
simp [M8.P4Family.support, M7.Supports.polynomial, M8.P4Family.polynomial,
  h0, h1, h2, h3, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23, hm,
  add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm]
